purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: academic interview; vocabulary (大学院/医学/書籍/経過/筆者) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生は、大学院で学ばれたんですね。
lines.en: You studied at graduate school, doctor.
lines.style: professional adult interviewer voice, soft warm engaged clarity throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ええ、大学院で医学を専攻しました。
lines.en: Yes, I majored in medicine in grad school.
lines.style: calm doctor voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 医学の書籍も、書かれたんですか?
lines.en: Did you write medical books too?
lines.style: engaged adult interviewer voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 筆者として、数冊出しました。
lines.en: As an author, I published several.
lines.style: gentle doctor voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 患者さんの経過も、書籍に?
lines.en: Did patients' progress go into the books too?
lines.style: curious adult interviewer voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 経過の記録を、丁寧に載せました。
lines.style: calm doctor voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 筆者として、伝えたいことは?
lines.en: As an author, what do you want to convey?
lines.style: probing adult interviewer voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 医学は、人のためにあると伝えたいです。
lines.en: I want to convey that medicine exists for people.
lines.style: warm doctor voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
